title: Claude's New AI Agent Messages You First
description:
Anthropic has opened a research preview of Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent that flags what needs your attention, sends a morning brief and keeps working in the cloud, but asks before it acts.
For now it's waitlist-only for Pro and Max subscribers in the US.
